Methods

@IsTest
private static void cursorTest1()

Tests the CursorIterator functionality by verifying it can iterate through Account records in batches, correctly track completion state, and return all expected records. Validates that:
  • Iterator is not empty when initialized with records
  • All records are fetched when iterating in batches
  • No records are returned after iteration is complete

@IsTest
private static void cursorTest2()

Tests the movePosition method of the CursorIterator by verifying that moving the cursor position correctly affects the records fetched subsequently. Validates that:
  • Moving position back to the start allows re-fetching of initial records
  • Moving position forward to the end results in no records being fetched
  • Fetching records after moving position behaves as expected
